تزدرعين (form VIII)
# تَزْدَرِعِينَ (tazdariʕīna) /taz.da.ri.ʕiː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past active indicative of اِزْدَرَعَ (izdaraʕa)
# تُزْدَرَعِينَ (tuzdaraʕīna) /tuz.da.ra.ʕiː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive indicative of اِزْدَرَعَ (izdaraʕa)
